title: Managed environments: re-show the add-people actions in Setup → Users (reverse #25295 / #25309's visible predicates for adding)
body:
repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9

Filing gate: ④ a child of the topic card objectstack-ai/cloud#4465 (the maintainer's rulings 1-10 of 2026-11-13/14 are recorded there; read it first). 

## 维护者速读

恢复「设置 → 用户」里加人、导入的按钮显示。这些按钮之前因为「托管只走云端邀请」被隐藏了。

## Work (objectstack-ai/cloud#4465 child 1b)
Reverse the `visible` predicates that hide adding people on a managed environment (#25295 / #25309). Point them at the new pending-user door (card F2). Password and local-credential actions stay hidden.

Blocked-by: #33181

`priority:p1` on the maintainer's word, verbatim (seat session `session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9`, 2026-11-14): 「都是p1，车道自己认领就可以」. Triage routes it to its lane; the lane claims it.
